purpose: Describe a recurring tendency, often an unwanted one.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
When I am busy, I tend to skip breakfast.
In winter I tend to stay indoors.
Recently he has been absent quite often.
restrictions: Often used for absence, forgetting, illness, or other negative patterns.
mistake: It describes a tendency, not necessarily something happening right now.
